notes.title: Important Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

Today is a tough day for us, and we need to share something honestly. Unfortunately, we have to pause the development of Inheritance: Ladeina’s Path. We apologize to those we may have disappointed or upset.

We could point fingers or make excuses, but the truth is, we faced numerous challenges, and some were beyond solving with our volunteer team. Everyone on the team gave their best, we worked hard, but we couldn't overcome certain obstacles. Losing team members affected our progress, and it's evident that if we don't pause now, it wouldn't be fair to those who believed in us.

We appreciate our dev team; they did everything to make this game a reality. While we achieved a lot, our dreams were vast. A heartfelt thank you to the patrons and players who supported and communicated with us.

Dear friends, we hope you can accept our apologies. If you have thoughts to share, please reach out. I am open to personal message feedback  too.

It's a sad moment, and we hope to find a way to continue in the future.

We loved you, we gave our best, but sometimes, it's not enough.

notes.title: Major Update For Season 1
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Kinky Lemurs,[/b]

We're absolutely delighted to announce that we're prepared for another Major Update.
First and foremost, it's important to clarify that this isn't Season 2, although we know you've been eagerly awaiting it. We had to make a significant decision. The current Season 1 isn't up to the standard we aspire to. Rather than immediately leaping into Season 2, we realized that we needed to enhance and expand Season 1 to provide a richer experience. There were areas where we weren't entirely satisfied, prompting us to undertake a Season 1 remake.

This build includes an upgraded Season 1 with new maps, expanded narratives, a revamped quest system, and prototype concepts for our sandbox mechanics. So, this isn't a minor update; it's the most extensive update we've ever undertaken. It serves as an excellent foundation for Season 2, ensuring we have a strong base to build future seasons upon.

With this update:
[list]
[*] Two out of the three levels have been remade.
[/list]
[list]
[*] A Photo Mode has been introduced.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Ladeina's Ritual has been prototyped and implemented into the Main Menu.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Astarte's model has been overhauled.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Animations have been improved.
[/list]
[list]
[*] A new Quest System and Compass feature, among other enhancements, are now available.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bug Fix
[/list]

You might have noticed that we've been working tirelessly to address and eliminate any game-breaking issues that came our way. However, it's possible that you may encounter some minor glitches. If that happens, please don't get upset, just let us know the issue, and we'll do our best to resolve it.

We've already begun work on Season 2 and will make every effort to release it as soon as possible. In the meantime, we'll be focusing on refining Ladeina's Ritual-Sandbox.
Thank you for your great support!

notes.title: Season 1 Is Undergoing Testing
notes.notes:
Hello Kinky Lemurs, 

[url=https://vimeo.com/814757979]WATCH TRAILER[/url]

After a period of quiet, we are back with some exciting news. We have started testing Season 1 with some awesome improvements! Our QA department and volunteer testers are thoroughly scrutinizing the game and identifying any bugs. If you would like to be a tester, [url=https://discord.gg/uZxMWTmzg8]please join our community and have a chance to win the DLC[/url] 

We'd like to provide you with an update on the game's progress. We know that the release of the new version has been delayed and we apologize for that. Our initial plan was to release it in March, but we require a little more time to ensure that we deliver the best possible product. However, we can guarantee that Episode 1 will be available in April. After making some enhancements and addressing some bugs, we'll offer the game to our patrons first and then to other platforms.

Here are some highlights of the upcoming release:

The average gameplay time for the first chapter will be approximately an hour.
Astarte can crouch silently and perform assassination attacks on unsuspecting enemies.
New execution animations will be available, allowing Astarte to perform various execution attacks.
Astarte will take damage from falling and have different damaged skin effects based on the level of damage.
Astarte can acquire and equip various special items to upgrade her stats.
Improvements to ranged attacks include a quick release and improved aim feature.
The navigational area has been expanded seven times.
Heavy and lunge attacks will consume stamina, and Astarte won't perform special attacks without enough stamina.
Two mini-puzzles have been added.
New features include V sync/FPS rate/motion blur option/invert Y, DLSS option, original soundtracks, and an extended UI and menu options.
Re-bindable keys are now available.
Our roadmap for the future includes completing episode 1 with this release, which is a significant milestone for us. We're just getting started and our goal is to tell an amazing story of Astarte. We're excited to see what's next and have some future plans in the works; 

*Switching to Unreal Engine 5
*Hiring permanent team members for the animation and character creation departments.
*A detailed character customization feature with different face/hair and appearance options.
*Adding NPCs to the world such as blacksmiths, merchants, brothel workers, and some additional interactive NPCs.
*Approximately one hour of additional gameplay
*Introduction of a sexual scene feature

If the game is successful, we plan to switch to Unreal Engine 5 at the beginning of May 2023 after completing bug fixes in April. Our goal is to release the new build in October 2023, which will be the last step before creating the full open-world map. As we make this game with a nearly zero budget, we have to be sure about what we have done before any step for the future takes place. Thank you for your continued support and patience!

notes.title: The First News of 2023!

Hello Kinky Lemurs

We hope you have a great start to 2023!  New year, new hopes!


In Inheritance: Ladeina’s Path, we are continuing to work hard. In the last update we mentioned that our lead designer had to quit because of his health issues.

We would love to talk about what we have done so far and what we are currently working on.

This release will be Episode 1 and it will have 3 different locations.   The first location is the ruined zone where you play the current build. We love to announce that we have mostly completed the general structure of the other locations.



We added the new enemies to the maps but still need time for completing all planned enemy types.

We announced that we are going to have 2 cutscenes, but we decided to add some fetish scenes (not too long). We want to make players feel what we feel about this opening episode and to use cutscenes to improve the game storytelling. And we decided to remove the second puzzle for the episode. There will only be one puzzle. 



2 weeks ago, our focus was on performance issues and the combat improvements. We have done a lot in these 2 fields. We expect 20-30% better FPS with the new build. And the combat / range system feels more fresh! We are planning to publish a combat dedicated video to Youtube soon.

We have rendered the opening scene and now we are planning to add sounds and voice acting that will be coming soon.



We have created 2 romance cards and they are now ready to be shared. We are planning to share these cards after the opening scene’s sounding is over. The video and cards will be free for all patrons forever. The google drive folder was created and we started to upload the files. That folder will be updated every time we create new assets.

For the rest of the month, we want to complete the new features and the quest implementations. At the same time, we are planning to complete all cutscenes.


Again we hope you will have a great year! May Ladeina be with you!

notes.title: The Last Update Of The Year
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Kinky Lemurs,
We hope you are all doing well in the last days of the year. With this update, we want to tell you about the progress and some decisions we have to make. 

[u]The updates will be live in the next release of Episode 1 ![/u]


[b]Dev Team:[/b] Inheritance: Ladeina’s Path started to be developed in June 2022 with a solo developer. By September, we had built the core team. After the first release, our team expanded even further. We have new friends in game design and animation fields. 
However, even though we strengthened our team with new members, our lead designer had to take a step back from the project because of some serious health problems. We hope for a speedy recovery for him and he will continue to be an important part of the project.  
Going forward in 2023, we are going to fill his roles.



From day one, we announced that we are making this game season by season and our community’s feedback will be what guides us on this path.


Nearly all feedback mentioned needing improvement to the combat system. We are working to merge the logics of the current combat system and we are planning to serve a better combat experience.


*We have a similar approach with the range attacks too.  
*We added some polishing to make the combat feel better. 
*Romance Cards will be added (the cards are unlockable with achievements) 
*The camera issue will be fixed 
*We fixed some locomotion animation issues
*The rebind-able key feature will be added 
*FPS limitation, VSync , Invert Y Axis Features will be added
*New execution animations will be added 
*Better GamePad Experience with new options 
*Better Optimization 
*Two New Maps
*Various Bugs Are fixed 



[b]RoadMap:[/b] Since our lead designer is on hiatus because of health problems, our release plan has been affected. We were planning to release Episode 1 in January 2023 but we have to delay the release time. SFX creation and Voice Acting are the main fields where we need to work. However, we don’t expect a dramatic delay but I think it is safe to say we may have around a one month delay. We will use this delay as an advantage for working more on the mechanics. 



[b]New DLC:[/b] We are really excited to announce that we are working on a new DLC! This DLC will contain every media asset and will be updated with new season releases. 

*All sexual cutscenes (Rendered/Realtime): The movie files will be 4K resolution
(2 Cutscenes: 1 Rendered, 1 Realtime movie for episode one)
*The OST: All original sound tracks will be added in this package 
*The Romance Cards: The collection of the erotic character hand painted cards. (Two cards in Episode One) 



[b]What is the motive of the DLC:[/b] We are planning to have a financial source for hiring more professionals into the team. We want to improve the game in the art and animation fields. The income of the DLC will be spent mostly in these fields.
[u]This will be the only DLC related to the media asset: [/u]Once you purchase, you will be updated with every release of the game. 

[b]The Plan:[/b] In 2023, we are planning to release two more Episodes. Around 15 sexual cutscenes, 20 Romance Cards and 5 Original Sound tracks
[b]The Price:[/b] We are planning to set the price around $9. This will be a great support for us! 



That’s all for now! have a great holiday and we wish an amazing new year! 

Kinky Lemur Games Team

notes.title: Season 1 Release - 25 .11.2022
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello Kinky Lemurs , [/b][/h3]
Making a build suitable for a release has been really tough on us. We do not blame anyone, this is all about us :) So first of all, we have to apologize for some confusion.

[b]What Happened;[/b]  
What Happened: We released the DLC before the main game was approved. This sounds strange, we know, but we are sorry if any of our friends in the community were confused by this. 
However, we just started and with these small issues we keep encountering, it gives us a huge advantage in avoiding future mistakes. 

[b]Lets talk about the game[/b] ( this is a really good chance for us to meet each other - before you go here is our video. It answers who we are) 
 [previewyoutube=I__xxZ8ICJw;full][/previewyoutube]

This build is the same as the demo; before you get upset, we have to clear something up about our releasing strategy;
We call this a [b]Season By Season Release[/b] - Since the first day of the game - even before we opened a new project in Unreal Engine - we decided to release this game season by season.  

[i]Making a game is not easy[/i] - This is not an excuse; this is a fact that we have to be aware of.  Even for AAA studios, releasing a complete game is a massive success even if they have millions for a development budget.  With amazing progress on the game engine side, now small teams can create "big" games with a lot of features and content. However, it is still a laborious   process.  We are not telling you why it is hard. This is not today's subject. We are telling you why we are releasing the game season by season. 

We started the project four months ago (July-2022) as a solo developer. With new members, we have managed to release a demo after just three months!  You have the opportunity to play that demo which has been tested and bugs corrected. 

*Around 20 Minutes of Gameplay
*Two Types of Enemies 
*A Boss Fight
*Some Softcore Nudity Content 
*One Level
*Inventory and Consumables 
*Two Types of Attacking
*Light and Heavy Attacks 

[b]Here is a question[/b]: Why did we release the game with a short amount of gameplay instead of releasing it as a demo?

A good and difficult question but we have to answer this:

In the Steam SDK, you cannot sell any DLC for your game (you can create but you cannot sell- :) ) if you haven't released your base application. We tried to release the demo and patch the DLC into it, but Steam would not allow that. So we were left with two options: we could leave the demo and not release the main build and DLC or we could release the main build, release the DLC and remove the demo. 
We had to choose the second. 

We are making this game with our personal savings and none of our teammates are full time developers. We currently do not have any investors or publishers. We have only our community and player base! So please take the time to play this game and DLC, and if you like what you see, then please consider supporting us and this project! : ) 

Here is a list what we are planning to add to the game in 2023:

* Level One Expansion - Total of Three Different Locations; Four Enemy Types, Three Mini Bosses and One Boss. 
* Two NSFW Cutscenes 
* Two Small Puzzles
* Detailed Character Customizations: Face and Body Customization 
* New Clothes for Astarte
* Level Two - Village Level: A Limited Open World: One Main Quest with Two Sub Quests. Around One Hour of Gameplay
* Unique NSFW Feature 
* Three New Enemy Types 
* Assassination Skill
* Riding Skill
* Fast Travel
* A Card Game
* Magic Combat
* Porting to Unreal Engine 5

Most of the features are planned but these will not be easy feats to complete without your support! That's why we decided to sell a Nude Mod patch. Buying this mod is a great way to support us but if you want to increase your role and make a bigger contribution towards the project, you are always welcome to support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Inheritance]Patreon [/url] . You will get amazing benefits. 

Thank you for reading and sharing your time with us! 

Save the date! 
25.11.2022

Cheers!
